# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native portrait-first arcade bus simulator called Bus Simulator: Chrome Commute Sweatlord. Preserve the source game's top-down driving loop: four mobile controls and arrow keys, accelerate/brake/reverse steering, generated city grid, building/traffic collisions, glowing pickup worth +500, pedestrian contact worth +50 and increasing five-step heat, health-based game over, restart, and camera follow. Transform the authored world into a satirical vaporwave Y2K transit simulator: a chrome-yellow bus driver chases neon rider pings for Clout Fare while fare inspectors and commuter traffic raise Lane Shame. Use procedural canvas drawing, chrome UI panels, cyan/magenta neon noir lighting, scanlines, readable mobile HUD, and catalog-approved Orbitron/Rajdhani fonts plus sci-fi audio accents.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: top-down arcade driving simulator with traffic, pedestrians, pickups, health, and fail state.
- objective: drive through a generated city grid, collect the glowing pickup for +500 score, survive traffic/building collisions, and continue raising score until the vehicle is destroyed.
- input model: keyboard arrow keys plus four touch buttons for left/right steering, gas, and brake/reverse; touch prevention is scoped to gameplay control buttons.
- core loop: start route, generate map, spawn player vehicle, steer/accelerate/brake through streets, collect pickup, traffic/pedestrian entities spawn around player, collisions damage health or raise heat, HUD updates score/health/heat, game over when health reaches zero.
- fail/friction state: building and vehicle collisions bounce the vehicle and damage health; hitting pedestrians increases wanted/heat by one and awards +50; at zero health the game over overlay appears with final score and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve acceleration, friction, turn speed, max speed, reverse limit, and camera follow behavior.
- Preserve map generation dimensions, road/building/park tile collision meaning, and wall collision checks.
- Preserve touch and keyboard input semantics: left/right steer only while moving, up gas, down brake/reverse.
- Preserve score semantics: +500 pickup, +50 pedestrian contact, five-step heat/wanted escalation, health-based failure.
- Preserve traffic spawning, entity collision thresholds, restart/start flow, HUD updating, and continuous requestAnimationFrame loop.

## Remixed target
Bus Simulator: Chrome Commute Sweatlord reframes the protected driving loop as a satirical vaporwave Y2K bus simulator. The focal actor is a chrome-yellow meme bus piloted by an overconfident commute sweatlord. The glowing pickup becomes a rider ping/fare clout marker, wanted stars become lane-shame heat, health becomes bus HP, police become fare inspectors, and the city becomes a neon noir transit grid with chrome UI, scanlines, mobile portrait controls, and retro leaderboard energy.
